title: Boutique Showroom
caption: A shop to walk through, lit by its own spots
blurb: A small boutique in the evening with six real products on plinths and shelves: click one and the camera walks over for a close look. The only lights are the shop’s own track spots, shelf strips and table lamp, so the pool under each product, its soft shadow and the reflections in the polished floor are traced as you watch; switch to day and the sun through the window takes over.
